rows.text:
Final checkpoint findings: a cancellation fixture left a child process alive; manual cleanup means that run is not accepted. Four model-inspection assertions also failed because three source inputs changed after the catalog build.
Commit 11f5607 reports early fixture exits; 73821ee caps Node test workers at four. A fresh complete build/models/unit/browser run is in progress with no skipped cases or retries. Cancellation root-cause correction is not claimed.
